text: Book online at citb.co.uk, by phone on 0344 994 4488, or directly through your local Internet Test Centre.
quote: You can book your test online through citb.co.uk, by phone on 0344 994 4488, or directly through your local Internet Test Centre.

text: Know which test type you are sitting (Operatives for most readers) and your preferred test centre.
quote: You will need to know which test type you are sitting (Operatives, for most readers of this guide), your preferred test centre

text: Have your contact details, your CITB candidate number (if you have sat a CITB test before) and a method of payment ready.
quote: your contact details, your CITB candidate number if you have sat a CITB test before, and a method of payment

text: Confirm the current test fee when you book (£22.50 at the time of writing; fees are reviewed periodically).
quote: At the time of writing the test fee is £22.50, though you should always confirm the current price when you book, as fees are reviewed periodically.

text: Remember the test is sat at a Pearson VUE or CITB-approved Internet Test Centre; it cannot be taken online from home.
quote: The HS&E test is sat on a computer at a Pearson VUE or CITB-approved Internet Test Centre — it cannot be taken online from home.

text: Check your ID the night before, not the morning of: without the required ID you will not be admitted and the fee is not refunded.
quote: If the required ID is not produced, you will not be admitted to sit the test, and the fee is not refunded — so it is worth checking this the night before, not the morning of.

text: Make sure your ID is original and in date; photocopies and digital copies are not accepted.
quote: You must bring original, in-date identification — photocopies and digital copies are not accepted.

text: Primary ID on its own is enough: a UK or international passport, a UK or European photocard driving licence, or a valid e-Visa.
quote: Primary ID (a UK or international passport, a UK or European photocard driving licence, or a valid e-Visa) is enough on its own.

text: No Primary ID? Bring two pieces of Secondary ID: one proving your identity with a photo, and one showing your name and signature.
quote: If you cannot provide Primary ID, you will need two pieces of Secondary ID instead: one item proving your identity with a photo, and one showing your name and signature.

text: Check the name on your ID matches the name on your test booking exactly.
quote: Whatever you bring, the name on it must match the name on your test booking exactly.

text: Expect 50 multiple-choice questions in 45 minutes (Operatives test).
quote: The Operatives test is 45 minutes long and contains 50 questions, all multiple choice.

text: Be ready for some questions with an image and some drag-and-drop questions where you place text into the correct position.
quote: multiple-choice questions shown with an accompanying image, and drag-and-drop questions where you place text into the correct position.

text: Apply for your CSCS card within two years of passing: the HS&E pass must have been achieved within the last two years.
quote: when you come to apply for your CSCS card, your HS&E test pass must have been achieved within the last two years.

text: For the card application, have a scanned copy of your test certificate, your HS&E test ID number, and payment for the separate card fee.
quote: To apply for the card itself you will need a scanned copy of your test certificate, your HS&E test ID number, and payment for the separate card application fee.
